promptBehavior: return one fixed acceptance marker; no tools or file changes
systemAcceptanceEvidence: Installed delivery calls UNUserNotificationCenter.add and sends completion.delivered only after its success callback; the observed ack succeeded and the new outbox row is delivered.
bannerVisibility: user later reported that a notification had arrived; exact displayed text was not captured
limits: OS acceptance and persisted delivery ack are verified. The user also reported an arrived notification; an independently captured banner/title is unavailable.
